verdict.rationale: BAMF is a government agency, so publishing bulk statistical datasets is a fair axis. The pack shows only a headline asylum figure on the homepage and the title of an annual monitoring report. Neither documents a downloadable dataset, registry extract or machine-readable statistics file that avoids scraping.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
